description: Name and address of manufacturer/packer/importer must be declared
suggestion: Include complete name and postal address of manufacturer, packer, or importer

description: Common or generic name of commodity must be declared
suggestion: Declare the common or generic name of the product

description: Net quantity in standard units must be declared
error_message: Missing or invalid net quantity declaration
suggestion: Declare net quantity in standard SI units (kg, g, ml, L, etc.)

description: Month and year of manufacture must be declared
suggestion: Declare month and year in format: 'Month YYYY', 'MM/YYYY', or 'DD/MM/YYYY'

description: Retail sale price must be declared with Rs./₹ symbol in prescribed format

validation.currency_error: MRP must include Rs./₹ symbol (Rs, Rs., Re., INR, ₹ or Rupees)

error_message: MRP format non-compliant with Legal Metrology Rules
suggestion: Use format: 'MRP Rs.XX.XX' or 'MRP ₹XX.XX (inclusive of all taxes)'

description: Consumer care details must be declared
suggestion: Include name, address, telephone number, and email for consumer complaints

description: Letter height must not be less than 1mm (2mm if embossed)
suggestion: Ensure all letters are at least 1mm height (2mm if embossed)

description: Declarations must be in Hindi (Devanagari) or English
error_message: Declarations not in Hindi or English
suggestion: Use Hindi (Devanagari script) or English for all declarations

description: No words exaggerating or misleading quantity allowed
suggestion: Remove words like 'minimum', 'about', 'approximately' from quantity declaration

description: Batch, lot, or serial number must be declared
error_message: Missing batch, lot, or serial number declaration
suggestion: Declare the batch, lot, or serial number on the package

description: Complete postal address of manufacturer/packer/importer must be declared
suggestion: Include the complete postal address with PIN code

description: Country of origin must be declared for imported goods
suggestion: Declare the country of origin for imported products

description: Name and address of importer must be declared for imported goods
error_message: Missing importer name and address for imported goods
suggestion: Declare the name and complete address of the importer

description: Best before/use by date must be declared where applicable
error_message: Missing or invalid best before/use by date declaration
suggestion: Declare best before or use by date in a clear format (e.g., DD/MM/YYYY or DD/MM/YY)
